mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals stronger household demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where GDPC1 accelerates > 0.5% qoq, fewer than 55% of 60-day forward returns are positive, or the median excess return is not statistically significant at p < 0.10.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tightening labor market, which raises wage pressure and input costs, reducing profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE drops below 4.0%, fewer than 45% of 20-day forward returns are negative, or the median excess return is not statistically significant at p < 0.10.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below -0.5% month-over-month signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below -0.5% m-o-m, fewer than 45% of 20-day forward returns are negative, or the median excess return is not statistically significant at p < 0.10.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below -10% signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls by more than -10% m-o-m, fewer than 45% of 60-day forward returns are negative, or the median excess return is not statistically significant at p < 0.10.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 0.5% month-over-month signals stronger labor demand, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS rises by more than 0.5% m-o-m, fewer than 55% of 20-day forward returns are positive, or the median excess return is not statistically significant at p < 0.10.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, fewer than 45% of 60-day forward returns are negative, or the median excess return is not statistically significant at p < 0.10.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Income (RSAFS) below -1% month-over-month signals weakening household purchasing power, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS falls by more than -1% m-o-m, fewer than 45% of 20-day forward returns are negative, or the median excess return is not statistically significant at p < 0.10.
